description: Edition-level NBA participant and phase facts. Unclassified provider games are never treated as regular season.

2023.format_details: 30 teams; preseason, regular season, play-in, postseason and All-Star events are distinct phases

participant_evidence.statement: NBA 30-club universe for the 2023-24 edition; phase metadata must come from provider-native season_type, never from the date.

2023.edition_notes: 2023-24 and 2024-25 each played 1230 regular-season games; play-in and postseason totals are not regular-season coverage.

playoffs.name: Play-in tournament
playoffs.format: Seeds 7-10 in each conference: 7 vs 8 decides the 7 seed; 9 vs 10 then meets the 7/8 loser for the 8 seed.

evidence.note: Postseason field is 16 clubs: six direct places plus two play-in places per conference. Series results are not asserted here.

competition_access.format: Closed franchise league: the 30 member clubs hold their places; entry is not earned through sporting promotion from a lower division.

evidence.note: NBA membership is a fixed franchise list rather than an annual promotion route.
The NBA is a closed league; no promotion or relegation route exists.

promotion_relegation.transition: None - closed franchise league with no promotion or relegation

evidence.note: NBA clubs are not promoted into or relegated out of the league.

playoffs.name: Conditional play-in (2020 NBA bubble)
playoffs.format: Top eight per conference qualified; where the ninth seed finished within four games of the eighth, a play-in decided the eighth seed.

evidence.note: 2019-20 was completed in the Orlando bubble under a temporary format; the play-in was conditional rather than a fixed four-team bracket.
